items.summary: Clean up backend entry points that accept a school name (Text) to call the shared resolve-or-create helper consistently, removing duplicate resolve/create/authorization logic at call sites while keeping outcomes identical.

Refactor the internal Motoko implementation of the existing private school helper(s) so the resolve-or-create-by-exact-school-name behavior remains identical, but the code is simplified and deduplicated (including factoring repeated checks, reducing nested switches, and improving readability).

Refactor manager-assignment logic used by school auto-creation to improve code quality without changing behavior, ensuring the same persisted effects on userProfiles and the same trapping behavior for invalid school IDs.
